about.title: I'm Leandro Zanardo.
about.subtitle: Building the backbone of modern digital experiences.
about.p1: I am a Senior Software Engineer with a passion for building complex, high-performance web applications. Over the past decade, I've navigated the evolving landscape of web technology, moving from front-end design to complex back-end architectures.
about.p2: My approach combines technical rigor with a deep understanding of user needs. Whether I'm optimizing a database query or fine-tuning a micro-interaction, my goal is always to create software that is as reliable as it is delightful to use.
